applies_why: The judge text compares the challenger's seed/loins chain and the defender's chain by their footing to resolve the collision, so it performs the chain-against-chain weighing K-C governs.
quote: the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter; the defender's chain is footed but rests on the woman-route inference.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse
room: The phrase chain against chain by footing could be read as satisfied by the judge's comparison of both chains' footing, or as requiring no mention of explicit naming; I read the text as comparing footing, not applying the retired stating-verse test.
why: The judge resolves the collision by noting the footing and inferential support of each chain, rather than by a verse-by-verse stating-verse test.
